request: Build a small Jac web app for a small hotel. Staff add rooms with a number, a type (single, double or suite) and a nightly price. A guest books a room for a check-in and check-out date. The app shows which rooms are free for a chosen date range and the total price of a booking. Keep the room and booking rules in a reusable service.
acceptance: A booking needs a check-out date after the check-in date.
A room cannot be booked for dates that overlap an existing booking of that room.
The total price is the nightly price times the number of nights.
The free-rooms list for a date range excludes rooms with an overlapping booking.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements paraphrased in English from the repository README/description; no code copied.
